AttentionDirective.description: Where someone wants a person to look, in order.

at.description: Time sent (filled in by the authority).

from.description: Who sent it (filled in by the authority; ignored if sent).

steps.description: Steps, in the order to show them.

AttentionStep.description: One step of an attention directive.

t.description: Bar open time, epoch milliseconds UTC.

oneOf.description: Series.
Views.
Facts.
Findings.
Capsules.
Intents.
Narratives.
Proposals.
Strictly less than.
Less than or equal.
Strictly greater than.
Greater than or equal.
Crosses the value upwards.
Crosses the value downwards.

Condition.description: A condition evaluated over series (invalidation, intent trigger).

oneOf.description: Last value of a series compared against a constant.

One series compared against another, both at the last bar (and the bar before,
for crossings). E.g. SMA(20) crosses above SMA(50):
`{"kind":"compare","left":"sma20","op":"cross_above","right":"sma50"}`.
For a bar series the compared value is the close.
Free text; evaluated by a person.

Depth.description: Semantic zoom level: 0 sentence, 1 capsule, 2 marked chart, 3 full workspace.

oneOf.description: Depth 0: one sentence.
Depth 1: the capsule.
Depth 2: chart with marks.
Depth 3: full workspace.

Gesture.description: A user gesture on a surface. Bars are 0-based indexes.

oneOf.description: The surface reports what is visible (e.g. after layout or a native scroll).
Scroll by a number of bars (positive = towards newer bars).

Zoom by a factor (> 1 shows fewer bars), keeping `anchor_bar` in place
(default: the last visible bar).
Tap or click on a bar in a panel; answered with what is there (`at`).
Mouse or trackpad.
Touch screen.
Keyboard.
Speech.
Watch crown or similar rotary input.

Instrument.description: A traded asset: where it trades and which calendar aligns its bars (K14).

calendar.description: Calendar id, e.g. `XIST`, `XNYS`. Bars are aligned to this calendar.

Layer.description: One layer of a view: a mark bound to a series.

encoding.description: Encoding: visual channel -> field or constant, e.g. `{"y": "v", "color": "#888"}`.

series.description: Series id; absent for constant marks (e.g. a rule).

oneOf.description: Candlesticks (needs bars).
Polyline.
Filled area.
Vertical bars.
Horizontal or vertical reference line.
Points.
Text label.

NarrativeStep.description: One step of a narration timeline.

at_ms.description: Start of the step, milliseconds from the start of the narration.

say.description: What to say (one or two sentences).

Op.description:
An operation in a command: what a human or an agent asks for, at the level of
meaning. The authority expands it into [`ChangeOp`]s (the replayable form).
Ids are optional where marked; the authority then assigns one (returned in
`ack.created`). All ids in a document are unique across all collections.

oneOf.description: Add or replace a series binding (by id).

Add a study (computed series) on input series, optionally showing it in a view.
E.g. `{"op":"add_study","study":"rsi","inputs":["px"],"params":{"period":7},
"show":{"view":"main","with":"rsi14"}}`.

id.description: Id of the new series; assigned if absent.

inputs.description: Input series ids (one bar series for the built-in studies).

params.description:
Parameters; missing ones take defaults (sma/ema/rsi: `period`; macd: `fast`,
`slow`, `signal`; bollinger: `period`, `k`).

oneOf.description: Change parameters of an existing study series (merged into the current ones).
Add or replace a whole view (by id).
Add a layer to a view.

index.description: Position in the layer list; appended if absent.

oneOf.description: Remove a layer from a view by position.

Set the visible bar range of a view (persistent; for a transient viewport use
`input`). Bars are 0-based indexes into the view's first bar series, inclusive.
Record a fact (normally the engine's job).
Write a finding (a claim resting on facts), optionally with its capsule.

capsule.description: Also create a live capsule with this headline.

facts.description: Fact ids it rests on (must exist).

invalidation.description: When this holds, the finding is invalid.

oneOf.description: Change fields of a finding; absent fields stay as they are.

A person approves a finding: its capsule becomes `approved` and the ledger
records it.

A person rejects a finding: its capsule becomes `rejected` and the ledger
records it with the note.
Leave a persistent request ("tell me if ...").

trigger.description: Machine-checkable trigger. Series it names must exist.

oneOf.description: Switch an intent on or off.
Add a narration timeline about an item.

about.description: Item id it narrates (usually a finding).

oneOf.description:
Ask the engine's presenter to build a view for a finding (the agent speaks at the
level of meaning; the presenter writes the grammar). The view is attached to the
finding's capsule.

view.description: Id of the view to create or replace; assigned if absent.

oneOf.description:
Remove an item by id. Removing a series also removes the layers that draw it;
it fails with `in_use` if other items (studies, facts, conditions) depend on it.
Append bars to a bar series (data feeds).

bars.description: Bars, strictly after the last bar.

oneOf.description: Replace the last bar of a bar series (a live, still-forming bar).

bar.description: The bar; same `t` as the current last bar.

oneOf.description:
Undo a log entry by writing its inverse as a new entry. Without `seq`: the
speaker's own latest entry that is not yet undone.

Accept a pending proposal: its operations are applied now, in the proposer's name
with the decider recorded as approver.
Reject a pending proposal.

Point.description:
One point of a single-valued series (e.g. an indicator output).

Warmup rule (K13): a study output always has one point per input bar, at the same
`t`. Points inside the warmup period have `v: null`; nothing is trimmed.

t.description: Point time, epoch milliseconds UTC (the time of the bar it belongs to).

oneOf.description: Waiting for a decision.
Accepted and applied.
Rejected.
Not decided before `expires_at`.

What this protocol endpoint offers: operations, queries, topics, principals,
and the asker's own role and permissions.
One item by id, from any collection.
All items of a collection. For proposals, `state` filters (e.g. `pending`).

full.description:
Include bulky data (the bars of bar series). Default false: series are listed
without `data`; read values with the `study` or `at` query, or `get` one item.

oneOf.description: The whole document and its log position (a snapshot, e.g. for hand-over).
Log entries. Filters combine with AND.

limit.description: Return at most this many (the latest ones).

since_t.description: Entries at or after this time (epoch ms).

until_t.description: Entries at or before this time.

within_ms.description:
Entries from the last this-many milliseconds (relative to `now`), e.g.
`1800000` for "the last 30 minutes".

oneOf.description:
Values of a series over a range, aligned with its bars (K13/K20), optionally
reduced to one number. For a bar series, outputs are `o`,`h`,`l`,`c`,`v`.

output.description: Only this output (e.g. `"signal"` of MACD); all if absent.

range.description: Range; the whole series if absent.

reduce.description: Reduce to one value per output.

series.description: Series id (a study series or a bar series).

oneOf.description: Everything at one bar: OHLCV and the value of every study on that bar series.

t.description: Bar time (epoch ms); the bar with exactly this `t`.

oneOf.description:
What a principal's surfaces show right now, semantically (views, panels, series,
visible bar range, capsules). The asker's own if `principal` is absent.

Where a principal is looking (last viewport and focus) and the attention
directives addressed to them.

A finding presented for a surface. Depth follows the asker's negotiated profile
unless `surface` names another surface kind.

finding.description: Finding id. If absent: the most important live finding (highest confidence).

surface.description: Present for this surface kind instead of the asker's.

Range.description:
A bar range. Exactly one form: `last` (the last n bars) or `from_bar`/`to_bar`
(0-based, inclusive) or `from_t`/`to_t` (epoch ms, inclusive).

Reduce.description: Reduction applied over a range (warmup `null`s are skipped).

oneOf.description: Smallest value (and its bar).
Largest value (and its bar).
Arithmetic mean.
First non-null value.
Last non-null value.
Number of non-null values.

Scale.description: A scale mapping data values to a visual axis.

domain.description: Fixed domain `[min, max]`; automatic when absent.

oneOf.description: Time axis.
Linear numeric.
Logarithmic numeric.

Series.description:
Time-based numeric data: bars, an indicator output or a stream.

In a [`Document`] a series acts as a binding: `source` says where data comes
from and `data` may be omitted.

instrument.description:
The instrument the series belongs to, if any. Its symbol lives here (there is no
separate `symbol` field), so exchange and calendar travel with it (K14).

oneOf.description: OHLCV bars, ascending by `t`.
Single-valued points, ascending by `t`.

SeriesSource.description: Where a series comes from. The core does not depend on the kind of source.

oneOf.description: Data is embedded in the series itself (`data`).
A local file.
A Matriks market data feed.
A NATS subject.
Local computation: a study applied to other series.

output.description: Which output of a multi-output study, if any.

Show.description: Where a new study is shown.

with.description:
Put it in the panel where this series is drawn (e.g. `"rsi14"`). Takes precedence
over `panel`. If neither is given, a new panel is added below the others.

max_depth.description: Upper bound on presentation depth the surface wants, below what its kind allows.

screen.description: Screen size in logical pixels `[width, height]`, if there is a screen.

SurfaceKind.description: Kind of surface a connection presents on.

oneOf.description: Large screen, pointer and keyboard.
Phone: small touch screen.
Watch: glance-sized screen.
Voice only: no screen; answers are spoken.
No presentation at all (an agent, a batch job).

Target.description: A step of a narration or an attention directive points at something.

from_bar.description: First bar index (0-based) of the region.

output.description: Output or field of the series, e.g. `"v"` (volume of a bar series), `"signal"`.

series.description: Series id (e.g. the series whose value matters).

to_bar.description: Last bar index (inclusive) of the region; equal to `from_bar` for one bar.

oneOf.description: Every applied log entry (optionally only those touching these item ids).

ids.description: Only entries touching any of these ids.

oneOf.description: State changes of one finding's capsule (live -> invalidated, approved, ...).
A condition becoming true (edge-triggered: notified when it turns true).
Proposals created and decided.

Attention directives addressed to a principal (default: the subscriber) and
that principal's reported viewport.
Active intents whose trigger becomes true.

View.description: A presentation recipe written in the visual grammar.

display_tz.description: Display time zone override (IANA); display only, see [`Document::display_tz`].

y.description: Vertical scale per panel, indexed by `Layer::panel`.

oneOf.description: Direct if permitted, otherwise a proposal (if the principal may propose).
Direct or fail.
Always a proposal.

description: A message from a client (UI, agent, data feed or host) to the authority.

oneOf.description: First message on every connection: who is speaking and from what surface.

principal.description: Principal id (a person, an agent, a feed), e.g. `"arkin"`, `"scout"`.

surface.description: The surface this connection renders on (capability declaration).

oneOf.description: A request to change the document: one or more operations applied atomically.

base.description:
Optimistic concurrency: the log position the client based this command on.
If an item the command touches changed after `base`, the command fails with
`conflict`. Omit to apply on top of whatever is current.

id.description: Client-chosen request id, echoed in the reply.

mode.description:
`auto` (default): write directly if permitted, otherwise create a proposal.
`direct`: fail with `forbidden` instead of proposing. `propose`: always propose.

ops.description: The operations, applied in order, all or nothing.

reason.description: Why (free text). Recorded in the log and shown on proposals.

oneOf.description: A read. Never changes the document.

id.description: Client-chosen request id, echoed in the reply.

oneOf.description: Ask to be notified about something; answered with `ack`, then `notify` messages.

id.description: Client-chosen request id; also the subscription id used in `notify.sub`.

oneOf.description: Cancel a subscription.

sub.description: The subscription id (the `id` of the `subscribe` message).

oneOf.description:
Raw user input on a surface (pan, zoom, tap, what is visible). The engine
interprets it; the reply is a `result` with the new viewport or the hit.

An attention directive: where the speaker wants a person to look, in order.
Does not change the document; delivered to the target's `attention` subscribers.

Host only: the current time. The authority has no clock of its own; time is an
input. Proposal expiry and log timestamps follow the last `clock`.

now.description: Current time, epoch milliseconds UTC. Must not go backwards.
